records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: you remember we told you obviously about Show Faith by Works LLC, that's that FARA-registered propaganda arm of the Israeli Foreign Ministry. ... they also included an entire detailed accounting of the propaganda that they intend to execute upon Christian minds. ... they are targeting evangelicals

verification.notes: The statement accurately describes what FARA registration 7653 and its Exhibit AB state: Show Faith by Works registered for Israel Ministry of Foreign Affairs, proposed Christian outreach in the United States, described pro-Israel and anti-Palestinian messaging, and included church and college geofencing. This verifies the filing claim; it does not assert that every proposed activity was ultimately carried out.
